resources.description: Return a bounded snapshot of native and ERC-20 holdings for one public Ethereum/Base address, with DEX-market observations, priced-holdings concentration, evidence and limitations. No investment advice.

Check one Base ERC-20 owner's direct allowance to one spender and compare it with the owner's current token balance at one block, returning normalized allowance exposure and deterministic large-approval evidence.

Fetch one public HTTPS URL and return deterministic structured web context: final URL/status, title/description, canonical, headings, readable content, structured-data types, freshness observations, evidence, and methodology.

Return currently observed factual Aave V3 and Lido lending/staking venues and rates for one supported chain and asset from Agent Mercantile's frozen V1 protocol set, with evidence, timestamps and limitations. Not a recommendation.
